title: Academic Tools in Development — tool.json
description: Metadata for one catalog entry. Lives at catalog/<slug>/tool.json.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema so editors can offer autocomplete.

summary.description: One or two sentences shown on the card.

type.description: What kind of resource this is. Controls the how-to-use instructions.

runsOn.description: Systems the tool works with, as free text (e.g. "Canvas", "Chrome", "Claude").

contact.description: An email address or https:// URL where people can reach the author.

lastTested.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the tool was last tested in its stated environment, or null if never.

source.description: Where the code lives, for linked tools (must start with https://).

files.description: Files in this tool's folder that visitors can view or download (hosted tools).

primaryFile.description: Which of the files the main button should use. Defaults to the first entry in files.

bookmarkletCode.description: Linked bookmarklets only: an https:// URL to the raw JavaScript (e.g. raw.githubusercontent.com) so the site can build the drag button.

dataHandling.description: One sentence on what data the tool reads, stores, or sends.

license.description: License identifier, e.g. MIT or CC-BY-4.0.

ferpaConfirmed.description: Must be true: the contributor confirms FERPA and student privacy were considered and no real student data is included.

todo.description: Marks a placeholder entry that has no working code yet.
